# IRwaOracleErrors
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/rwa-oracles/src/interfaces/IRwaOracleErrors.sol)

**Title:**
IRwaOracleErrors

Interface defining errors raised by the Real World Asset (RWA) Oracle contract.


## Errors
### InvalidSignature
Reverted when submitted signatures are not strictly ascending by
signer address (i.e. unsorted or containing a duplicate signer).


```solidity
error InvalidSignature();
```

### NotEnoughSignatures
Reverted when the number of valid signatures is below the threshold.


```solidity
error NotEnoughSignatures();
```

### StalePrice
Reverted when a price update payload has a timestamp that is too old.


```solidity
error StalePrice();
```

### FuturePrice
Reverted when a price update payload has a timestamp from the future.


```solidity
error FuturePrice();
```

### Unauthorized
Reverted when a recovered signer is not an authorized signer.


```solidity
error Unauthorized();
```

### InvalidConfiguration
Reverted when configuring invalid state variables (e.g. threshold > total signers).


```solidity
error InvalidConfiguration();
```

### DuplicateSigner
Reverted when adding a signer that is already registered.


```solidity
error DuplicateSigner();
```

### NoDataPresent
Reverted when querying price data before any price has been set,
or when the queried round ID is zero or out of range.


```solidity
error NoDataPresent();
```
